texts.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的船员报告称科学专员[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，导致[malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer]彻底无法行动。
texts.en: The crew of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] reports that Science Officer [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction, rendering [malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer] permanently inoperable.

texts.zh: 讽刺的是，因[malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer]对实验室器材维护过分谨慎而臭名昭著的科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，原因是个人机体长期缺乏维护。
texts.en: In a bitterly ironic twist, Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] - notorious for [malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer] meticulous care of laboratory equipment - has suffered a critical malfunction following a prolonged lack of personal maintenance.

texts.zh: 科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]在长期暴露在高度辐射性的地质样本下后发生了致命故障，因其内部辐射计数器损坏而未能察觉。
texts.en: Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction after prolonged exposure to a highly radioactive geological sample, due to a faulty internal radiation meter.

texts.zh: 指挥官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因制造缺陷而发生了致命故障。
texts.en: Commander [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a terminal malfunction due to a manufacturing error.

texts.zh: 总督[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障——彻底失灵——原因是在例行维护中安装了损坏的固件。
texts.en: Governor [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction - "bricking" - following the unfortunate installation of corrupt firmware during routine maintenance.

# 合成领袖已损坏 / Synth Leader Out of Commission

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/on_action_events_1.txt:7064-7236; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5165-5168 on_synth_leader_malfunction · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

合成（机械物种）领袖故障死亡时（on_synth_leader_malfunction，00_on_actions.txt:5165-5168）随机四选一，各占1/4：科学船领袖、研究总督、舰队统帅、行星总督。

When a synthetic (mechanical species) leader malfunctions (on_synth_leader_malfunction, 00_on_actions.txt:5165-5168) one of four events is picked at random, 1/4 each: science-ship leader, head of research, admiral, planet governor.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

四个窗口互斥，各自杀死一名符合条件的机械领袖（相应触发不满足则不会出现）；唯一选项UNFORTUNATE。

The four windows are exclusive; each kills one matching mechanical leader (no event if its trigger fails); the single option is UNFORTUNATE.
